title: RAW370 development: two whole powder-preparation paragraphs with explicit partition, quantity and reference alternatives

new_compositional_commitment.semantic_rule: MeasuredNP(POWDER, one Q) may be written ctho daiin or as their exact concatenation cthodaiin, with the same full nominal content before discourse reference or goal scope is applied.
new_compositional_commitment.known_instances: f21r.8 cthodaiin in all readings; f32v.8 ctho daiin in ZL/IT and cthodaiin in RF.
new_compositional_commitment.limit: One explicitly proposed local construction, not a confirmed productive -daiin affix. The other five compound alternatives are individually disclosed reader-grouping hypotheses, not evidence for universal word fusion. No extra letters, deletions, reordering or entity resolution.

shared_construction_contract: MaterialNP is a fixed material-kind head with at most one mass-unit run and any explicitly written compatible properties. A mass-unit run of n adjacent daiin tokens denotes n*Q of one referent; n=1 or2 in this source. It is not n duplicate property assertions and not n independent referents.

The unnumbered material at the paragraph opening introduces one source batch. ACQUIRE also introduces a source batch. Paragraphs have separate accounts; identical kinds across pages never identify physical batches.

Finite operations are evaluated in written order after their own typed arguments and adjuncts are attached. Instrument/location/manner adjuncts can precede or follow their immediately associated operation; the complete clause trees below fix attachment. Mere mention of a goal, inventory or result does not execute an operation.

FOR_OUTPUT records the goal of the current source preparation: material kind, mass and written properties, plus descent from that source. It introduces no physically available powder and is not an initial-state assertion.

UNTIL binds its following property or MaterialNP to the selected output of its immediately preceding operation. RINSE preserves the patient; SIEVE produces a selected passing fraction and a disjoint residue. The goal concerns the selected fraction and preserves source ancestry, never a full-mass copy of the parent.

CRUSH/GRIND create one prepared solid bulk with coarse and powder submaterial; dry matter is conserved. DRY removes carrier water, not the tracked plant-solid mass. RINSE may remove external dirt, not the tracked desired plant-solid amount. These are idealized procedure assumptions, not observed physical measurements.

An explicit inventory of measured material NPs immediately preceding SEPARATE exhaustively describes disjoint components of the current prepared bulk in CARRY. It does not add fresh material. SEPARATE physically separates these components, preserving each amount.

COARSE_GRIST, COARSE_PART, COARSE_FRACTION and the COARSE selector refer to the coarse branch of a grade partition. FINE_PART and the FINE selector refer to its powder branch. RESIDUE selects the coarse branch of that same partition; it never means an arbitrary unmentioned waste.

LIFT_OUT selects and moves the named available branch into the active work position; it does not dispose of that material. Other branches remain available. SORT followed by KEEP and a measured product list partitions the active input exhaustively and without loss into those named products. FIBRES and GRANULES are distinct coarse-product kinds, not additional powder aliases.

KEEP stores material without creating, consuming or duplicating it. Successive KEEP predicates select the corresponding existing partition branches; repeated mentions are observations/actions on one object, not new portions. COVER acts on the active last selected branch; STORE_SEPARATELY retains it as a separate stock.

RETRIEVE requires an existing available matching material and cannot introduce a fresh stock. Bare reference NPs choose the latest available compatible material, using kind/properties and the partition relation; a tie or absence is a failed reference, not permission to invent a referent. Goals are excluded from available material.

The ingredient list before KNEAD jointly supplies its listed inputs. In CARRY, a material already present under the required kind/property is reused; a first-mentioned WATER or OIL supply may be introduced externally. A missing POWDER input cannot be repaired as a new supply. KNEAD consumes the selected powder into one paste batch, retaining its tracked plant-solid amount.

ONE PORTION counts the resulting batch, not its mass. Water and oil quantities are unspecified physical supplies; they are not assigned Q, and their masses are not added to the plant-solid subaccount. WITH_MEDIUM WATER GRIND requires water already present as a component of the active paste. It adds no new water. It can refer to that component after KNEAD has incorporated it, without making it a second free water stock.

The same rules apply throughout both paragraphs. There are no line-boundary resets, hidden material switches, empty fillers, zero-mass named solid fractions, unnamed extra powder or post-hoc exception productions. An explicitly named coarse or fine product has positive plant-solid mass.

primary_whole_readings.draft: Nimm frisches Wurzelmaterial; trockne und zerkleinere es für ein herzustellendes Ergebnis von einer Masseneinheit trockenem Pulver.
Spüle mit Wasser, bis das Material gereinigt ist; danach breite das Pflanzenmaterial dünn und gleichmäßig aus.
Trockne in der Sonne; vermahle grob; trenne mit einem Sieb den groben vom feinen Anteil.
Bewahre den feinen Anteil auf; bewahre den groben Anteil auf. Decke den groben Anteil mit einem Tuch ab; danach lagere diesen Rückstand getrennt.
Nimm das verfügbare Pulver; siebe, bis der gewonnene Pulveranteil fein und gereinigt ist und eine Masseneinheit umfasst.
Wurzelmaterial: zerkleinere es; trockne über Nacht im Schatten; danach durchmische die vorbereitete Gesamtmenge gründlich und gleichmäßig.
Im vorbereiteten Material: zwei Masseneinheiten grobes Mahlgut und eine Masseneinheit Pulver. Trenne diese Teile; hebe den vorhandenen groben Anteil heraus.
Sortiere diesen groben Anteil mit einem Sieb; bewahre eine Masseneinheit Faserstücke und eine Masseneinheit Körnchen auf.
Wasser und Öl sowie eine Masseneinheit des verfügbaren feinen Pulvers: verknete diese Zutaten zu einer Portion Paste.
Vermahle diese Paste mit dem bereits darin enthaltenen Wasser.

changes_from_raw370.chol: DRY -> FINE; it is a particle-grade property, not a drying event or plural inflection
changes_from_raw370.daiin: unspecified prescribed amount C*U -> one globally fixed positive plant-solid mass unit Q; repeated tokens add, with no absolute numerical value recovered
changes_from_raw370.sheey: SPREAD_OUT -> SIEVE; it now partitions material and cannot duplicate its full input mass
changes_from_raw370.chkaiin: READY -> CLEAN; a concrete output property, not an unconstrained success flag
changes_from_raw370.sho: LIQUID -> WATER; stronger hypothetical kind, no picture/source confirmation
changes_from_raw370.cpho: TRITURATE -> KNEAD; chy separately carries GRIND in both paragraphs
changes_from_raw370.ykeey: TAKE -> RETRIEVE existing material; acquisition cannot be supplied silently
changes_from_raw370.new_values: Every other entry is newly stipulated here, even if its German gloss resembles an old working card. No historical working gloss is treated as evidence.
changes_from_raw370.dain: Not part of RAW370's14-word lexicon. Here THOROUGHLY, a new singleton manner assumption; old P05/P14 quantity guesses are neither inherited nor repaired. dain does not encode3Q or the total bulk.

fixed_rival.unchanged: All lexical values, operations, goal scopes, written amounts, source strings and alternative-reading assumptions remain as in CARRY.
fixed_rival.single_changed_rule: Each unmarked material list immediately before a new separation or kneading clause introduces fresh input portions, including an already-mentioned material kind. Explicit DEFINITE, RETRIEVE, KEEP and UNTIL bindings are unchanged.
fixed_rival.f32v_8_consequence: The two measured coarse units and one powder unit are newly supplied; the .7 prepared bulk is not thereby identified with them and remains unused by the written later clauses.
fixed_rival.f32v_9_consequence: The new coarse2Q still partitions into fibresQ and granulesQ. The new powderQ remains available.
fixed_rival.f32v_10_consequence: The written chor chol daiin introduces another fine powderQ for the paste. It requires an additional available powder supply and leaves the powderQ from .8 unconsumed. CARRY instead consumes that .8 powder; neither spelling nor ordinary recipe plausibility alone selects these reference conventions.
fixed_rival.f21r_consequence: No relevant unmarked separation-input or kneading-input list occurs here; explicit RETRIEVE still returns to the prepared powder branch and FOR_OUTPUT remains a prospective source-owned goal.
fixed_rival.interpretation: A coherent rival with different material prerequisites and leftover stocks, not a defeated reading. No unprinted ALL/NOTHING-LEFT condition is introduced to reject it.

new_written_consequences: CARRY binds the two consecutive daiin on .8 to one coarse referent, giving2Q, and the next ctho daiin to a disjoint powder referent of Q. No quantity is counted twice merely because its material is mentioned again.

The .9 FIBRES Q and GRANULES Q exhaust the coarse2Q. Therefore its active output cannot also supply the .10 powderQ. CARRY must retrieve the untouched powder branch from .8, across the intervening work on the coarse branch.

Thus the dry plant-solid account is3Q = (fibresQ + granulesQ) + powderQ. KNEAD moves that last Q into the paste; it does not add a fourth Q. ONE PORTION asserts one resulting batch, not massQ. Final WATER/GRIND changes neither the ancestry nor the tracked solid amount.

Under CARRY, changing the local referent of .10 to the active coarse branch requires an absent powder product or consumes one of the explicitly retained fibre/granule portions. Changing it to a fresh input requires the FRESH rival's added supply and leaves an extra powder stock. These are distinct content obligations on the complete written continuation.

In f21r, the fused cthodaiin goal and the final chor chol daiin output must use the same Q and powder kind. The first mention is future-directed and cannot discharge the later RETRIEVE precondition. The actual powder must arise from the written drying/grinding/separation steps.

The second paragraph uses the same powder-grade-quantity description as the first paragraph's selected output, but the pages need not refer to one batch. Type compatibility is predicted; a historical transfer between the two roots/plants is not.

The final ol sho chy requires water as an existing component of the paste. Under WITH_MEDIUM it cannot supply a missing wetting step itself; that medium was explicitly introduced by sho in the preceding complete kneading clause. The second sho is not counted as a new water portion.
limits: All lexical values and the identity, quantity, no-loss and scope rules are hypotheses constructed after seeing both paragraphs. The conditional mass equation is not a measured manuscript fact or an independently predicted successful equality.

The two whole texts are now annotated without unknown filler, but most distinct forms are singletons. This development can make a rival disagree; it does not make the present lexicon likely or historically true.

No universal r/l operation is claimed. chor POWDER versus chol FINE is a kind/property contrast within separately learned wholes, and the known915/916 results do not license it. GDT608 supplies no semantic value to the listed operators.

The complete alternative readings are given conditional values, including entity-bearing wholes and compound hypotheses. These are additional assumptions preserving source uncertainty, not normalization, image resolution or three replications.
A corresponding plant image need not depict powder production. No plant identity, powder appearance, tool depiction or text-picture alignment is asserted.

RAW370, W44/W45, P05/P14, W89, W94/W96 and GDT915/916/949/981–985/994 remain unchanged. In particular, the old P14 forest is not retroactively a closed quantity cycle. Closure is newly stipulated here through this model's explicit partition and reference rules.
No simulator, new corpus search, experiment, reserve opening or automatic proposal registration was performed. Mechanical annotation completeness is not a semantic PASS.

The ADD versus repeated-assertion contrast does not select ADD over two separately allotted portions of Q each: the latter has the same aggregate amount and can be collectively referenced. This ambiguity is retained in the fixed TWO_EQUAL_PORTIONS rival.

scientific_costs.selection: All assignments, aliases, clause scopes and reference rules were selected with the two paragraphs visible.
scientific_costs.free_measure_parameters: Q>0; absolute initial mass in f21r; water/oil quantities; drying/rinsing durations except the guessed overnight adjunct. No parameter was estimated from a new target observation.

quantity_diagnostic_rival.scope: Same complete lexicon, source-owner references, disjoint partitions, exhaustive lossless SORT and all other constructions; change only the repeated quantity-run interpretation.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.changed_rule: Two adjacent daiin assert massQ twice of the same one material, instead of adding to2Q.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.local_written_consequence: The coarse material in f32v.8 then has Q, while its two disjoint stored products in f32v.9 each have Q; conservation requires Q=Q+Q, impossible for Q>0.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.decision: This repeated-assertion interpretation conflicts with the NEW common partition contract. It does not refute old P14 M, which did not assert this same partition and ownership graph.
escape_costs: Allow overlapping product descriptions rather than disjoint FIBRES/GRANULES fractions.
Allow an additional named or unnamed coarse input, gain of tracked plant solid, or nonexhaustive reassignment of .9 to another stock.
Change one or more fixed Q values.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.limits: Those would be different complete contracts. The two printed product names alone do not prove disjointness. No calibrated preference for the additive contract or decoded number follows.
quantity_diagnostic_rival.loss_robustness: The local contradiction does not require exact zero loss: with nonnegative loss L it would require Q=2Q+L, impossible for Q>0. No net addition of tracked plant solid remains essential.

quantity_and_identity_obligations.Q: One unknown positive common mass unit for tracked plant solid; no gram value or dimensionless three is identified.
quantity_and_identity_obligations.f21r: Goal(powder,Q,dry,descent-from-initial-root) is not stock. After drying and partition, a positive coarse branch is stored. The final sieve selects powderQ from the fine branch and leaves a possibly empty derived remainder. Thus total starting plant-solid amount must exceed Q under the stated no-new-solids/positive-coarse assumptions. This is a conditional input requirement, not an observed initial quantity.
quantity_and_identity_obligations.f32v_carry: B=C+P; C=2Q; P=Q; SORT(C)=F+G with F=Q and G=Q; KNEAD(P,W,O)=T; final GRIND uses T.W, not a new W. Products C,F,G,P,T are not all simultaneous independent masses: C is consumed into F+G, and P into T.
quantity_and_identity_obligations.f32v_fresh: The .8 measured list creates fresh C and P and leaves the earlier prepared bulk unused; the .10 list creates another powderQ and leaves .8 P unused. F/G and T are still coherent. No ALL/NOTHING-LEFT requirement is supplied to dismiss this rival.

predecessor_notes.retained_limit: The same f32v doublet was already tested as paired qualities with equal values; no external arity support. This offer makes neither that inherited quality count nor III into a fact and does not repeat its census.

Old M explicitly read repeated daiin as two assertions of Q on one material; old R had a forest without written closure. The new additive and partition assumptions are changes of hypothesis, not corrections to old results.
The repeated chor chol daiin and fused/separate boundary lead pre-exist this offer; no discovery credit or inherited dry/III meaning.

schematic_productions.status: A manually offered finite construction inventory, shared by both paragraphs; no claim of a discovered or uniquely parsed grammar.

rules.semantics: Conjoin compatible explicit properties and one mass amount on one referent; properties may precede or follow the unit run. No hidden kind.
Q or2Q in CARRY; the fixed reiterated-assertion rival changes only the second alternative to Q asserted twice.
One product batch; no mass equivalence to Q.
Introduce the initial source stock and source-owner preparation frame.

The explicit object must resolve to the current preparation stock or available compatible material; otherwise the active stock is the object. Adjuncts attach to the operation in this clause, never create material.
Use the explicitly named first-mentioned supply on the active plant patient. The supply does not become the patient; a following UNTIL property still tests the patient/output.
Evaluate the next complete clause after the previous complete clause; no reset.
Constrain the selected eventual product of the current source preparation, retaining ancestry. Do not create physical inventory.
Constrain the selected output of that operation; properties apply to that output, and a repeated material kind is an output reference, not fresh input.

rules.schema: ExplicitSeparation := SEPARATE_BY_GRADE CoarsePartNP FROM FinePartNP ToolAdjunct
rules.semantics: Produce two disjoint branches from the active bulk and associate the written references with those outputs.
Two measured disjoint components exhaust the current prepared bulk in CARRY; physically separate them. The FRESH rival instead supplies a new bulk of the written input portions.
Select one existing branch and move it to the work position without discarding or duplicating it.

rules.schema: SortedPreservation := SORT ToolAdjunct KEEP MaterialNP MaterialNP
rules.semantics: The named measured products are two disjoint exhaustive outputs of the active source, both retained. Their names do not by themselves establish disjointness; the construction does.
Select the corresponding existing partition branch by its grade and store it; property nominalization is licensed only in this construction.
Retain the referenced existing branch separately; no input or transformation.
Select an existing available matching material; a missing referent fails rather than creating supply.
Jointly consume the listed ingredients into the specified product. CARRY reuses an existing compatible solid and allows first-mentioned WATER/OIL supplies. FRESH introduces new listed inputs.
Use that already-contained material as medium of the active product; there is no addition or second supply.

schematic_productions.parsing_limit: The supplied complete clause trees select intended scope within this finite offer; ambiguity and competing parses have not been exhaustively searched. No raw group is silently omitted or interpreted only as a line-number instruction.

semantic_scope_notes: RINSE WATER UNTIL CLEAN uses water as the written supply of RINSE; CLEAN tests its plant patient/output. Water does not take over the plant role merely because its noun was mentioned last.
SPREAD THINLY PLANT_MATERIAL EVENLY keeps the plant patient from the current source preparation. It is not a new unnamed ingredient.
MIX PREPARED_BULK redistributes one already-composite particulate bulk. It does not require two unprinted coingredients.
f21r KEEP FINE and KEEP COARSE select two branches created on .10. The subsequent WITH_CLOTH COVER applies to the most recently selected coarse branch, and RESIDUE names that same branch.
f32v KEEP FIBRES Q GRANULES Q is one product-list construction after SORT, not two repeated mentions of a common named type. The products are separate outputs by explicit construction assumption.
The second WATER on f32v is a component reference inside the paste, not a new supply or a reuse of water as independent free inventory.

Drying, cleansing, particle grade and material ancestry are separate coordinates. Process words do not guarantee success under every physical starting condition; the reading imposes explicit conditions on a successful execution.

version.amendment_policy: Any substantive revision after the review freeze requires a separately labelled version or addendum; preserve this offer for criticism.

quantity_individuals_rival.changed_rule: Each daiin in an adjacent run denotes its own allotted portion of the same material kind, each of massQ, rather than one 2Q portion. Other reference and transformation rules are unchanged.
quantity_individuals_rival.aggregate_consequence: The two coarse portions together still have2Q. SEPARATE groups all coarse material into its coarse branch while preserving the identities of any constituent portions. LIFT_OUT DEFINITE COARSE_FRACTION can therefore refer to that collective branch, and the same3Q balance remains possible.
quantity_individuals_rival.what_is_not_selected: The mass equation cannot distinguish one coarse portion2Q from a collective of two coarse portionsQ+Q. No claim that ADD has been selected over this allocation is justified.
quantity_individuals_rival.identity_cost: If COARSE_FRACTION were required to pick one indivisible portion, two equal candidates would cause an ambiguity and onlyQ would be active; that stricter singular reference is not a fact about the word and is not silently imposed. No later source group in this offer identifies either original portion individually.

conservation_assumption_levels.local_routing: C supplies both distinct retained products F and G. Reiterated assertions give C=Q; F=G=Q, so Q>=2Q is impossible even with nonnegative loss. This requires that SORT cannot borrow stock from another branch.
conservation_assumption_levels.global_closure: Even without specifying that particular path, an exhaustive starting stock of2Q under the reiterated reading cannot supply three disjoint still-present terminal stocks F,G,paste-solid of Q each, with no later input of tracked plant solid. Exhaustiveness, absence of a hidden stock/new supply and disjoint terminal survival are explicit hypotheses, not observations supplied merely by repeated words.
conservation_assumption_levels.additive_requirement: Under ADD the starting3Q equals the three required terminal quantities, so the interval must have zero net loss of tracked plant solid. ADD is not established if the actual process entails a positive such loss.
conservation_assumption_levels.portion_equivalence: Two separately allotted Q portions in the coarse branch have the same aggregate2Q as one ADD portion. This dataset/contract does not decide their original individual identity.
conservation_assumption_levels.source_scope: These are conditional algebraic consequences of the new whole reading. They neither assign a historical quantity unit nor turn P14's different old ratio forest into a measured cycle.
